in_a_reel: WORD is the payoff word the speaker says; the plate covers the whole picture for HOLD seconds, the speaker only shows through the letters
the buyer's style wins: set the STYLE block at the top of build.py to the reel's caption style before the first build (effects/INDEX.md, Restyling an effect's own words)

run build.py SAFE=1      # prints the stack, the plate, the snapshot times and the caption window
hf snapshot --at 0.5,1.0,1.5      # use the times build.py printed
run check.py      # frame count, work/check/sheet.jpg, phone copy
